name: Hon Bay Canh
summary: Turtle nesting islet: boat about 45 minutes from the town jetty, then walk the long beach and the hill. A booked night runs 18:00–06:00, with at most 50 people at one site. The adult scenic fee is 60,000 VND. The boat fare is Check on arrival.
fee: 60,000 VND scenic fee. Boat: Check on arrival
getThere: About 45 minutes by boat from the town jetty.
heroCaption: Hòn Bảy Cạnh from the water: the hill and a rocky shore
admissionNote: Adult scenic fee 60,000 VND on route 2 or 3. A night guide, when a ranger leads, is 350,000–600,000 VND by group size, and half if no turtle is seen. Hatchling release is 50,000 VND. The boat fare is Check on arrival.
gettingThere: The boat from the town jetty takes about 45 minutes.

The same night rules also cover Bãi Dương, Hòn Cau, Hòn Tài, Hòn Tre Lớn, and Bãi Đất Thắm. The cap is 50 people at one site, in at most five groups of about 10. Outside guides keep their own talk off the beach.
